hints: Since heights are measured to the nearest cm, class boundaries are: 9.5 to 19.5, 19.5 to 29.5, 29.5 to 39.5, 39.5 to 44.5, 44.5 to 49.5, 49.5 to 54.5, 54.5 to 59.5.
Start curve at (9.5, 0), label axes 'Height (cm)' and 'Cumulative frequency', and join with a smooth curve.
walkthrough:
Calculate the cumulative frequencies and upper class boundaries for continuous heights (measured to nearest cm):
$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}
\hline
\text{Height Interval} & \text{Upper Boundary} & \text{Frequency} & \text{Cumulative Frequency} \\
\hline
10\text{--}19 & 19.5 & 10 & 10 \\
20\text{--}29 & 29.5 & 18 & 28 \\
30\text{--}39 & 39.5 & 32 & 60 \\
40\text{--}44 & 44.5 & 42 & 102 \\
45\text{--}49 & 49.5 & 28 & 130 \\
50\text{--}54 & 54.5 & 14 & 144 \\
55\text{--}59 & 59.5 & 6 & 150 \\
\hline
\end{array}$$

Plot the points at upper class boundaries on linear scales:
$$(19.5, 10), \quad (29.5, 28), \quad (39.5, 60), \quad (44.5, 102), \quad (49.5, 130), \quad (54.5, 144), \quad (59.5, 150)$$
Connect with a continuous, non-decreasing curve starting from $(9.5, 0)$, with clearly labelled axes.
teacher_walkthrough:
Step 1: Understand continuous data boundaries:
Heights are rounded to the nearest centimetre.
The interval $10\text{--}19$ actually covers $9.5 \le h < 19.5$.
Thus, the upper class boundaries are: $19.5, 29.5, 39.5, 44.5, 49.5, 54.5, 59.5$.

Step 3: Plot and join:
Plot points at the upper boundaries, starting at $(9.5, 0)$, and join them with a smooth increasing curve.

hints: The 30th percentile corresponds to 30% of the total frequency N = 150.
Calculate the position: 0.30 * 150 = 45 on the vertical cumulative frequency axis.
Trace horizontally from cf = 45 to your curve and read the height on the horizontal axis.
Expect a value between 34 cm and 36 cm.
walkthrough:
Determine the cumulative frequency corresponding to the $30$th percentile for $N = 150$ sunflower plants:
$$\text{Position} = 0.30 \times 150 = 45$$

Read the corresponding value of height from the horizontal axis at cumulative frequency $45$:
$$\text{30th percentile} \approx 35\text{ cm} \quad (34 \le \text{height} \le 36)$$
teacher_walkthrough:
Step 1: Calculate the cumulative frequency value for the 30th percentile:
$$\text{Cumulative frequency} = 30\% \times 150 = 0.30 \times 150 = 45$$

Step 2: Read from the graph:
Locate $45$ on the vertical axis (cumulative frequency).
Move horizontally across to meet the cumulative frequency curve, then vertically down to read the height on the horizontal axis:
$$\text{30th percentile} \approx 35\text{ cm} \quad (34\text{ to } 36\text{ cm accepted})$$

hints: Find the class midpoints x for each interval:
walkthrough:
Calculate the estimated mean:
$$\bar{x} = \frac{\sum fx}{\sum f} = \frac{5840}{150} = 38.933 \approx 38.9\text{ cm} \quad (38.93 \le \bar{x} \le 38.94)$$

Calculate the estimated standard deviation:
$$\sigma = \sqrt{\frac{\sum fx^2}{\sum f} - \bar{x}^2} = \sqrt{\frac{244439}{150} - \left(\frac{5840}{150}\right)^2}$$
$$\sigma = \sqrt{1629.5933 - 1515.8044} = \sqrt{113.7889} \approx 10.667 \approx 10.7\text{ cm}$$
$$(10.66 \le \sigma \le 10.7)$$
